Great question! Setting up your new Leesa mattress is super easy. Here’s a simple guide to get it right on the first try: 💡

Move the box to your room first. It's much easier to unbox it where it will live.
Unbox with care. Place the box on its side and be careful with any sharp objects to avoid damaging the mattress.
Position and unwrap. Place the rolled-up mattress on your foundation or base and remove the outer plastic wrap.
Unfold and free the mattress. Tear away the inner plastic. A pro tip is to start at the top and pull it off like a sock.
Watch it expand! The mattress will take shape right away. Make sure the stripes are facing up toward the ceiling.

Your mattress may take up to an hour to fully expand and a few days to fully firm up. Any slight odor is normal and will fade quickly. For more details, you can check out this article: How do I set up my Leesa mattress?
